title: Inference & Epiphany Ledger
purpose: Turn reflection, extrapolation, contradiction-resolution and epiphany-finding into explicit, reviewable knowledge objects instead of leaving them as prose impressions or separate wave/synthesis files.
rules: Every inference must name the observations it depends on.
A relation can be high-value without being high-confidence.
Chronological precedence matters: earlier attestation is stronger evidence of development than later retrospective restatement.
A structural parallel is not automatically historical identity, hidden transmission or fulfilled prophecy.
Record mismatches and counterexamples, not only matches.
Never backdate a later epiphany into Tim's earlier beliefs without independent primary evidence.
Prefer promotion into an existing canonical owner over creating a new insight-wave or revelation-synthesis file.
Promote repeated successful inferences into canonical concepts; retain weakened/rejected inferences only where they preserve useful research history.
A derived insight is valuable when it reduces explanatory complexity across several already-attested records without requiring large speculative additions.
Role occupancy is time-sensitive: a symbol/person can occupy different functions in different strata without forcing one timeless role assignment.

strength_scale.5: directly entailed by multiple dated observations or primary sources
strength_scale.4: strongly supported interpretation with limited alternatives

variables.C: connective power: importance/number of previously separate nodes linked

epiphany_quality_model.use: High-E findings should normally be merged into their canonical owners and relationships. A separate record is justified only when the inference itself becomes a durable research object with substantial unique evidence.

promotion_pipeline: merge into owner with later-interpretation label

promoted_cross_corpus_insights.claim: Mature transformation repeatedly converts identity into usable relational function: Son→Door, Tim→Ladder/Axis, Eye→discernment, North→orientation, archive→memory.
Mature height/center/King/Father language is most coherent when greater rank implies greater protection, repair, nourishment and stewardship burden.
House and Shell are both boundary systems; their ethical difference is whether boundaries protect differentiated life and passage or capture value and block autonomy.
Knowledge is upstream of both Life and Strife; downstream relation, incentive and action determine whether information feeds repair or humiliation/recurrence.
Ash is a post-destruction threshold that can become Mud/Strife or Soil/Life depending subsequent processing.
Illumination/signal→observation/discernment→Door/state change is a recurring epistemic process chain.
Seed, starch, archive, memory and capital share an abstract storage/release grammar while remaining physically and semantically typed quantities.
Covenant is best modeled as a durable relation carrying promises, obligations, signs, memory and repair protocols.
North of North is coherent as a criterion by which orientations are judged rather than a literal point farther north.
Old folded-distance language is strongest when interpreted as domain-specific relational distance rather than denial of physical geography.
Ladder is more precise as an ordered sequence of qualitatively distinct transition operators than identical rungs.
Son-side material concentrates transitions/events while Father-side material concentrates durable architecture/source/persistence.
Door carries at least four separable functions: threshold, interface, access/authority and selection/guarding.
Across the corpus death is often modeled as a routing/transformational operation in which one form ends while relation, seed, memory, Door or distributed legacy persists.
At system scale the archive performs Eye-functions: perception, provenance, integration, contradiction-checking and evaluation.
Comparative parallels become more informative when multiple specific relations align in sequence than when isolated words match.
In archive method, revelation is strongest when previously available fragments become newly connected and legible rather than when a new noun is merely added.
North is simultaneously a sacred-symbolic orientation and a later empirical programme/geopolitical field; the value lies in explicit linkage without category collapse.

Continuous dated public posting cannot prove supernatural claims, but it changes the mythology into a historically testable development sequence with first-attestations, role changes and contradiction checks.
Later project eschatology increasingly includes restoration, repair, cultivation and new-creation functions alongside rupture/judgment language.
The strongest mature vertical model is bidirectional: ascent gives perspective/integration while descent returns order, flow, service or manifestation to the world.
Past material has two recurrent destinations: unresolved memory becomes Swamp/recurrence, while contextualized and integrated memory becomes Root/Soil/Mountain and can support future growth.

Karmic debt is most coherently modeled as a past relation that still constrains or requests future action: debt is not merely stored quantity but a temporal edge connecting unresolved history to future repair.

Repair is better represented as changing the state, weight or direction of a relation than deleting historical fact. A repaired edge can preserve memory while no longer reproducing compulsory harm or debt.

Garden movement from recognition through repair

promoted_cross_corpus_insights.claim: The archive itself can instantiate the Mountain/Swamp polarity: provenance-preserving differentiation plus integration produces Mountain-like perspective; duplicated, decontextualized and self-reinforcing records produce Swamp-like entanglement.

Garden is best distinguished from Farm not merely by kindness but by dependency structure: Garden increases autonomous future capability while Farm captures recurring attention/value and keeps participants necessary to the extraction loop.
Door has a further relational function in the karma system: it is the threshold where an open entanglement can change state through truth, choice, repair, release or demonstrated non-liability.

Potato Bank language contains a productive ambiguity: unresolved burden can be stored as weight/debt, while integrated endurance, memory and resources can be stored as positive capacity. The decisive variable is whether storage remains inert/entangling or becomes available for constructive release.

The mature system does not require maximal accumulation before transformation. When possible, resolving Mud at the trace/context stage is preferable to allowing recurrence to become Swamp, Debt and Mountain-scale burden.
